items.title: FOSSASIA PGDay 2027: Bangkok, 9 March – CFP Open
items.summary: We are happy to announce that FOSSASIA PGDay returns to Thailand on 9 March, 2027, bringing the PostgreSQL community together at True Digital Park, Bangkok. Visit the PGDay website for more details.About EventFOSSASIA PGDay is an annual gathering for PostgreSQL users, developers, and enthusiasts, bringing together the community from across Asia and beyond. Co-located with the FOSSASIA Summit, the event provides a focused forum for sharing knowledge, practical experiences, and insights into PostgreSQL and its growing ecosystem. Previous editions have taken place in Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, and Indonesia, connecting local communities with contributors, users, and organizations from around the world.FOSSASIA PGDay highlights PostgreSQL in real-world applications and its role as a scalable, secure, and cost-effective open-source data platform. It also creates opportunities to build connections within the PostgreSQL community and the wider open-source ecosystem.Call for ProposalsThe CFP is open until November 30, 2026. Slots are limited, so early submissions are encouraged. 👉 Submit your proposal hereKey TopicsFOSSASIA PGDay features a single-track program, giving all participants the opportunity to follow the same talks and discussions throughout the day. Following the technical program, a social event will provide an opportunity for community networking, informal discussions, and collaboration in Bangkok. We welcome proposals on topics including:PostgreSQL development and administrationPerformance, scaling, and high availabilitySecurity and reliabilityCloud, containers, and infrastructureData engineering and analyticsExtensions and ecosystem toolsMigration and modernizationReal-world deployments and case studiesPostgreSQL community and adoptionCall for SponsorsPGDay is made possible through the support of sponsors. We invite you to share the prospectus with your company or contacts. For questions or to discuss sponsorship opportunities, please feel free to get in touch. 👉 View the Sponsorship Prospectus

items.title: SLES 15.6 repositories are being retired
items.summary: The SLES 15.6 repositories are being retired from the main PostgreSQL RPM repository, and are moved to the PostgreSQL ZYPP archive .General support for SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) 15 SP6 (15.6) ended on December 31, 2025 (by upstream).All PostgreSQL major versions that were built for these minor releases are available there, including PostgreSQL 18.If you are still on SLES 15.6 either update to a newer SP (SP7 at the time of this writing), or use the archive. The archived repositories section of the repository packages page generates the repository file and the install commands for each distribution version, architecture and PostgreSQL version: https://zypp.postgresql.org/repopackages/#archivedreposPlease note that these repos will not receive further updates.If you have any questions, please either email to pgsql-pkg-yum@lists.postgresql.org, or create a ticket at our issue tracker .
